text:
Carmen: Quick check — onboarding 5566 weights are uploaded but tokenizer mapping looks off when using chat template.
Ben: where's the weights path? I can repro if I mount the same gcs bucket
Carmen: gs://redwood-models/5566/weights/sha-abc123
Amy: ack, I'll pull and run our tokenizer sanity script
David: fyi llama3-style special tokens differ: we saw <s> vs <|start|> behavior. might be the pad->eos remix
Ben: Ran quick token diff, BOS/EOS indices mismatch by 2 for the shipped tokenizer file
Carmen: hmm, could be we converted using the generic converter. @infra-bot can you confirm which converter job ran at upload?
infra-bot: uploader_job_882 completed by ml-onboard-bot at 2026-02-10T18:22Z. converter=hf-generic-v1
Amy: that's the one. it maps BOS->0, EOS->1 whereas our chat runtime expects BOS=1, EOS=2 for streaming KV cache offsets
Ben: Quick suggestion: patch the tokenizer json to remap special_tokens_map and reupload, or adjust chat template to use explicit sentinels
Carmen: example patch snippet:
```
"special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "pad_token": "<pad>"}
```
Ben: or in chat template prefix use `<s>
User: {user}
Assistant:` — but that will change token counts
Amy: Running a validation run now: `python infra/tools/tokenizer_check.py --path gs://redwood-models/5566/tokenizer.json --check-bos-eos`
ml-onboard-bot: validation started (run-id 992). ETA ~3m
David: If validation fails, we should 1) update tokenizer json 2) add converter flag `--preserve-specials` 3) add a test in PR pipeline
Carmen: I'll file a tiny PR to switch converter flag. Assigning to @Ben for review. Ben can you take it?
Ben: yep, will review this afternoon :+1:
Amy: after PR merge, I'll re-run the validation and run a short perf smoke on dedicated infra
Carmen: cool — follow-up: update weights path in model registry to point to `sha-abc123` folder so runtime picks correct tokenizer
Ben: noted. I'll also add a short note in model onboarding checklist about verifying BOS/EOS indices
Carmen: Thanks all — ping here when validation completes :eyes:
ml-onboard-bot: validation PASSED (run-id 992) — special token mapping OK, suggested fixes applied to staging copy
Ben: saw the pass, merging PR now. :shipit:
Amy: smoke perf looks fine on staging, no latency regressions
Carmen: closing this thread, created follow-up ticket MLOPS-1234 for checklist update (action: Ben)
David: (reacted :thumbsup:)
